ledger_entries_reference_ck.name: ledger_entries_reference_ck
ledger_entries_reference_ck.value: ("billing"."ledger_entries"."type" in ('CHARGE', 'REFUND') and "billing"."ledger_entries"."payment_id" is not null) or ("billing"."ledger_entries"."type" not in ('CHARGE', 'REFUND') and "billing"."ledger_entries"."voucher_id" is not null)

reconciliation_reports_mismatches_ck.name: reconciliation_reports_mismatches_ck
reconciliation_reports_mismatches_ck.value: case when jsonb_typeof("billing"."reconciliation_reports"."mismatches") = 'array' then ("billing"."reconciliation_reports"."status" = 'MATCHED') = (jsonb_array_length("billing"."reconciliation_reports"."mismatches") = 0) else false end

audit_logs_actor_id_ck.name: audit_logs_actor_id_ck
audit_logs_actor_id_ck.value: ("identity"."audit_logs"."actor_type" = 'system' and "identity"."audit_logs"."actor_id" is null) or ("identity"."audit_logs"."actor_type" <> 'system' and "identity"."audit_logs"."actor_id" is not null)

conversations_closed_state_ck.name: conversations_closed_state_ck
conversations_closed_state_ck.value: ("messaging"."conversations"."status" = 'CLOSED') = ("messaging"."conversations"."closed_at" is not null and "messaging"."conversations"."close_reason" is not null)

messages_system_shape_ck.name: messages_system_shape_ck
messages_system_shape_ck.value: ("messaging"."messages"."kind" = 'SYSTEM') = ("messaging"."messages"."sender_id" is null) and ("messaging"."messages"."kind" = 'SYSTEM') = ("messaging"."messages"."system_code" is not null)
